Strategy: Medium-gap preference. Prefer leaving a residual between half and the full item size, since such a gap can hold a medium item; tighter fits rank next, and bins leaving room for another full item rank last. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit is very tight while another bin leaves a medium gap. It may help by keeping gaps usable for medium items, but may fail if later items are large and need the roomier bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [200.0 - (r - item) if r - item >= item / 2 and r - item < item else (100.0 - (r - item) if r - item < item / 2 else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Medium-gap preference: residual in [item/2, item) ranked best, tighter next, roomier last.
